_README: Optimus kill list. Edit this file to lock machines. Read license_gate.py.
_how_to_deny_one_machine: add its 16-char id to 'denied'. The id prints in the DEACTIVATED notice on that PC, and in RUN_HUNTER's startup line.
_how_to_kill_everything: set kill_all=true AND kill_all_confirm to TODAY's date (YYYY-MM-DD). A bare true with no matching date is deliberately IGNORED.
